results.title: India orders Apple to remove Bitchat from App Store under Section 69A
results.subject: science_tech
results.why_in_news: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology ordered Apple to remove Bitchat from its App Store under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act.
results.fact_box: India accounted for 85% of Bitchat downloads between July 17 and July 23. The app was removed from the App Store, Google Play, and various websites following user protests.
results.mains_question: Discuss the balance between state security measures under Section 69A and the fundamental right to freedom of speech and privacy in the digital age.

results.title: India records 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26, exceeding NLEP target by 91.6%
results.subject: social_justice
results.why_in_news: The Union Health Ministry reported that India recorded 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26, significantly exceeding the National Leprosy Eradication Programme (NLEP) target for child cases.
results.fact_box: India recorded 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26 with a prevalence rate of 0.56 per 10,000 population. The number of new child cases (3,832) exceeded the NLEP target of 2,000 by 91.6%, while the national Grade-2 disability (G2D) rate stood at 1.34 per million.
results.mains_question: Critically analyze the challenges in achieving the National Strategic Plan for Leprosy 2023-27 despite existing eradication programs.

results.title: India identifies 28 geographical features on SoI map following PLA troop movements
results.subject: security
results.why_in_news: The Government of India identified 28 geographical features on the official Survey of India (SoI) map following PLA troop movements along the LAC since April 2020.
results.fact_box: The identification was conducted in consultation with the Union Territory administration of Ladakh. The list comprises 11 peaks, five mountains, six land areas, two glaciers, two passes, one valley, one river, one lake, and one water body.
results.mains_question: Discuss the significance of accurate cartographic mapping in maintaining territorial integrity and managing border disputes in the context of the LAC.

results.title: Spintronics AI and CSIR-CEERI sign MoU to establish indigenous GaN fabrication facility
results.subject: science_tech
results.why_in_news: Spintronics AI Semiconductors and CSIR-CEERI signed an MoU on October 02, 2026, to establish an indigenous Gallium Nitride (GaN) fabrication facility in India.
results.fact_box: The partnership involves Spintronics AI Semiconductors and the CSIR-Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CEERI). The initiative targets the GaN market, which is projected to grow from $224 million in 2026 to nearly $1.88 billion by 2033.
results.mains_question: Discuss the significance of developing indigenous semiconductor fabrication facilities for India's technological sovereignty and economic growth.

results.title: Naidu and Sitharaman lay foundation for ₹1-lakh-crore Global Horticulture Hub in Madanapalle
results.subject: agriculture
results.why_in_news: N. Chandrababu Naidu and Nirmala Sitharaman laid foundation stones for a ₹1-lakh-crore Global Horticulture Hub and the Indian School of Agriculture in Madanapalle.
results.fact_box: The 'Global Horticulture Hub - Rayalaseema Rising' project is supported by Reliance Industries and covers 5,860 villages across 10 districts. It aims to increase production from 222 lakh tonnes to 435 lakh tonnes for 9.6 lakh farmers.
results.mains_question: Discuss how large-scale horticulture hubs and specialized agricultural institutions can enhance farmer incomes and achieve food security in India.

results.title: UNFCCC Executive Secretary praises Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III scheme
results.subject: science_tech
results.why_in_news: UNFCCC Executive Secretary Simon Stiell praised the Centre's approved Green Energy Corridor Phase-III (GEC-III) scheme for its scale in renewable energy evacuation.
results.fact_box: The GEC-III scheme is a Rs 1.86 lakh crore project featuring an intra-state transmission system and Rs 50,000 crore for 50 GWh of battery energy storage systems. It aims to evacuate 135 GW of renewable energy with Rs 54,082 crore in central financial assistance.
results.mains_question: Discuss the significance of large-scale battery energy storage systems in achieving India's renewable energy targets and ensuring grid stability.

results.title: 2026 marks lowest monsoon in a decade as El Nino causes drought threshold deficit
results.subject: geography
results.why_in_news: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reported that 2026 recorded the lowest monsoon rainfall in a decade due to a strengthening El Nino causing a deficit that crossed the all-India drought threshold.
results.fact_box: India received 759.4 mm of rainfall between June and September, which was 87% of the Long Period Average (LPA) of 868.6 mm. The rainfall deficit crossed the threshold used to define an all-India drought year.
results.mains_question: Analyze the impact of El Nino and the Indian Ocean Dipole on India's monsoon patterns and its implications for national food security.

results.title: Google launches Planet Labs satellite on SpaceX rocket to test Tensor Processing Unit
results.subject: science_tech
results.why_in_news: Google launched a Planet Labs satellite on a SpaceX rocket to test its Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) in orbit as part of Project Suncatcher.
results.fact_box: Google's Project Suncatcher aims to develop an 81-satellite network for orbital compute clusters. The satellite will operate the TPU in 15-minute bursts to manage power and thermal constraints.
results.mains_question: Discuss the significance of orbital compute infrastructure in the evolution of Artificial Intelligence and space-based data processing.

results.title: Andhra Pradesh High Court sets aside BC reservations exceeding 50% threshold in local bodies
results.subject: polity
results.why_in_news: The Andhra Pradesh High Court set aside Government Orders (G.O. Nos. 105 and 1065) because the proposed reservation for Backward Classes in local bodies exceeded the 50% constitutional threshold.
results.fact_box: A Division Bench of the Andhra Pradesh High Court, led by Chief Justice Lisa Gill and Justice Challa Gunaranjan, struck down reservations of 34% for Backward Classes in Panchayat Raj Institutions and 33.33% in Urban Local Bodies. The court ordered the State Election Commission to conduct elections by October 1, 2026.
results.mains_question: Discuss the constitutional validity of state-level reservation policies that exceed the 50% ceiling in the context of local self-governance.

results.title: 80% of Mumbaikars refuse 0.4% MDR on UPI payments above ₹2,000
results.subject: economy

results.fact_box: The 0.4% MDR applies to person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI payments above ₹2,000, effective October 15, 2026. The MDR is capped at ₹300 per transaction for payments of ₹75,000 and above.
results.mains_question: Discuss the economic implications of introducing a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI payments and its potential impact on the digital payment ecosystem in India.

results.title: Nirmala Sitharaman invites global investors to Chicago roundtable to highlight GIFT City

results.mains_question: Discuss the role of Special Economic Zones like GIFT City in attracting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and enhancing India's position in global manufacturing supply chains.

results.title: Kerala High Court directs government to expedite pending cases against MPs and MLAs
results.subject: polity

results.title: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is set to hold its Monetary Policy Committee
results.subject: economy

results.title: Maharashtra allocates ₹6,728 crore for drought relief, boosts dairy sector

results.title: Rajasthan Issues 90.19 Lakh Digital Farmer IDs, Exceeding 2015 Census by 118%

results.title: Karnataka Chief Justice forms committee to examine bench in coastal region

results.title: Delhi bans non-compliant vehicles from November 1 under strict new Winter Action Plan

results.subject: security
results.why_in_news: A Pakistani social-media influencer, Shahzad Bhatti, has been linked to terror-related investigations across 14 Indian States for mobilizing followers to perform subversive tasks.
results.fact_box: Shahzad Bhatti is a Pakistani influencer whose activities led to arrests in 14 Indian States. Followers were charged under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act (UAPA) for tasks including installing CCTVs near critical installations and making extortion calls.
results.mains_question: Discuss the challenges posed by social media as a tool for radicalization and cross-border coordination by non-state actors in the contemporary security landscape.

results.title: Study attempts to find out how India made expensive diabetes medicines affordable - The Hindu
results.subject: social_justice
results.why_in_news: A study led by V. Mohan, chairman of Dr. Mohan’s Diabetes Specialities Centre, examined India's model for making expensive diabetes medicines affordable for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).
results.fact_box: The study, published in 'Diabetes Care' on September 19, 2026, highlights that 80% of the 589 million adults with diabetes globally reside in LMICs. It focuses on making modern therapies like GLP-1 receptor agonists, SGLT2i, and analogue insulins accessible.
results.mains_question: Discuss how India's pharmaceutical model for affordable healthcare can serve as a blueprint for low- and middle-income countries to manage chronic diseases.
